messages:
elena: Heads up — AcmeHealth is hitting 403s when users SSO from their IdP after they rotated signing certs this morning. They say login used to work, nothing changed on our side.
sam: Can you paste the exact error they see? 403 could be assertion validation or recipient mismatch.
elena: Error from our SAML endpoint: `Assertion failed: signature verification error` then `recipient mismatch: https://redwood.app/sso/acs` in logs. They forwarded IdP metadata and the new cert chain.
kevin: @elena can you confirm ACS URL in the SP config matches the ACS in the SAML request? Sometimes IdP encodes trailing slash or adds querystring.
elena: Confirmed: our configured ACS is `https://redwood.app/sso/acs` (no trailing slash). Their SAMLRequest Recipient shows `https://redwood.app/sso/acs/` (trailing slash). They rotated certs at the same time — could be 2 issues.
sam: Hmm, trailing slash difference should be normalized by our router but the signature check fails before recipient check sometimes. Do we have the exact SAMLResponse payload? ask them for base64 blob.
elena: Got the blob, pasting minimal log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z saml: Received SAMLResponse for sp_entity=urn:redwood:connect
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z saml: Signature verification failed: key thumbprint NEQ expected
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z saml: Recipient in assertion: https://redwood.app/sso/acs/
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z saml: Metadata lookup: idp.example.com -> cached metadata age 23m
```
kevin: Cached metadata age 23m — maybe their IdP pushed new metadata out and our cache hasn't revalidated due to TTL. But signature failing suggests we picked the wrong cert (maybe old cert removed and new cert added at end of KeyDescriptor list).
elena: Their metadata includes two KeyDescriptor entries. New cert is the 2nd one. They said their IdP expects relying parties to accept either cert, but older SPs fail when the first key is removed or order changes.
oncall-ops: tagging: @kevin @sam — if we pick the first KeyDescriptor only, that explains signature mismatch. Our metadata parser should try all signing keys, but there's a historically-configured optimization to only keep the first for perf. We should not do that for IdPs that rotate keys without a rollover key.
sam: For immediate workaround can we fetch their metadata URL and force a cache refresh, and also accept alternate certs for this tenant for the next 24h?
kevin: Yes, I'll trigger a manual fetch and add the new cert thumbprint to the tenant override list. Steps: 1) curl metadata URL, 2) update idp_cert_cache for tenant id 8642, 3) restart SAML verifier worker (graceful). I can do this in 10m.
elena: I told customer we'll do a manual sync and confirm within 15m. They're running a scheduled rollout so it's urgent.
kevin: Doing step 1 now — fetching metadata: `curl -s https://idp.acmehealth.com/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -` shows two <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries with different X509Certificates.
kevin: Pushed cache refresh and added thumbprint override `TH:3A:7B:...` to tenant 8642 via admin console. Restarting verifier worker.
sara-bot: [incident] Created support-8763; severity P2; assigned to kevin. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/8763
kevin: Verifier worker restarted — tailing logs.
kevin: Log now shows `Signature verified using cert thumbprint TH:3A:7B:...` and then `Recipient normalized: https://redwood.app/sso/acs` — request accepted.
elena: Customer confirms they can log in now. They also reported intermittent failures earlier — likely propagation window while some IdP nodes served old metadata.
oncall-ops: Follow-ups: 1) remove tenant override after 72h once we confirm stable; 2) add telemetry counter for cert-order related signature fails; 3) add automatic multi-key verification (attempt all signing keys) instead of optimizing to first key only.
sam: Also add a small normalization step to compare ACS with and without trailing slash before rejecting recipient.
elena: I'll open a runtime ticket for the config change and a separate feature ticket for parser improvement. @kevin can you paste the exact admin CLI commands you used so support runbook can be updated?
kevin: CLI snippet used:
```
redwood-admin idp fetch-metadata --tenant 8642 --url https://idp.acmehealth.com/metadata.xml
redwood-admin idp add-cert-override --tenant 8642 --thumbprint "TH:3A:7B:..." --reason "post-rotate temporary"
systemctl restart redwood-saml-verifier.service
```
elena: Perfect, I'll update the KB and inform AcmeHealth they'll see reduced chance of break during rotation. :thumbsup:
sam: Nice triage team. Recommend we run a short job to scan customer metadata for multi-key rotations and proactively warn customers who only list a single KeyDescriptor.
elena: Agreed. Closing thread once runbook entry merged.
